Apple's silicon-plus-OS stack is still the widest integrated consumer technology stack, but in 2026 the company rented the one layer it could not build — the frontier model — so what remains defensible is distribution, custom silicon and regulated health sensing, not leadership in artificial intelligence [S58, S64].

### Three grants show where the estate points: health sensing and the inherited modem
